svg.title: The parts of a simple C++ program, labelled
svg.desc: A four-line C++ program with each part labelled by a line pointing to it. The first line, hash include iostream, is labelled a preprocessor directive that brings in the input and output library. The line int main open paren close paren open brace is labelled the function where execution begins. The line beginning std colon colon cout is labelled the statement that prints text, and its backslash n is labelled a newline character. The line return 0 semicolon is labelled reporting success to the operating system. The closing brace is labelled the end of main.

g.text: Every program in this book has this shape.
